scope: static selection evidence only; no Cargo, browser, server or original-report mutations

method.file_integrity: every declared file compared to production manifest SHA256 and bytes; manifest unchanged at end

compression.meaning: normalized gzip budget, not a claim that the measured HTTP responses were compressed

method.html: executable script src, stylesheet/modulepreload/preload hints, eager img and external SVG refs; templates/noscript, navigation/download anchors and canonical/OpenGraph metadata excluded
method.modules: literal ES module imports followed; executed islands.js boot options resolve glue and wasm, including loader dynamic import(glue_url)
method.css: external CSS url/import are conservative selector/media/font candidates; data URLs already included in CSS bytes and do not add requests
method.lazy: loading=lazy and unexecuted URL literals excluded; no navigation or user-triggered download added
method.conditions: actual current CSS has only three data SVG URLs and no external fonts; no conditional network CSS/srcset/icon resources in these closures
method.observations: A response body SHA/bytes/gzip and ResourceTiming checked; B response bytes/gzip and ResourceTiming checked, since original B meter did not record SHA or image bodies
method.page_representation: Each page is its verified HTML metrics plus the referenced shared non-HTML dependency set; totals equal exact per-file raw/gzip sums.

timing_sources.A: 23 original r1 pages plus valid radio r3; previous radio failures remain in untouched original reports
timing_sources.B: two five-sample pages; the B sizes list omits its eager logo, but raw ResourceTiming includes the logo
